blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
HR stands for Human Resources. It is the team that takes care of people at the company.

At Czarnikow, the HR team hires new employees. It supports the current team. It makes sure everyone is happy at work.

Today you will learn five important words. We start slow. You can do it!

items.q: What does HR stand for?
items.why: "HR stands for Human Resources." — HR é Recursos Humanos.

items.q: What does the HR team take care of?
items.why: "It is the team that takes care of people at the company."

items.q: How does the lesson start today?
items.why: "We start slow. You can do it!"

items.q: The HR team hires new employees. This suggests that the company is…
items.why: Inferência: contratar novos funcionários indica que a empresa está crescendo.

items.q: The writer would most likely AGREE with which idea?
options: You should study alone, with no help
You can learn, one step at a time
Learning English is too hard for you
items.why: Inferência: o tom é encorajador — "We start slow. You can do it!"

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie recebendo um novo colaborador no primeiro dia. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to Czarnikow. My name is Sophie. I am from HR.

Today is your first day. I am very happy to meet you. Do not worry. I am here to help you.

Let me show you the office. It is not big, but it is nice. Your desk is here, next to the window. The kitchen is on the left. Coffee and tea are free.

Our team is small. We are only four people, but we are friendly. If you have a question, just ask me. My job is to help you.

Here is your badge. You need it to open the door. Please keep it safe.

Let me tell you about the company. Czarnikow works with sugar and food. It is an old company, but the team is young. People come from many countries. English is our main language here, so do not be shy. We all make mistakes, and that is okay.

At ten o'clock we have a short meeting. You can meet the team. Take your time. The first day is always a little strange. But soon you will feel at home. Welcome to the team!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is Sophie?
items.why: "My name is Sophie. I am from HR."

items.q: Where is the new employee's desk?
items.why: "Your desk is here, next to the window."

items.q: Why do you need the badge?
items.why: "You need it to open the door."

items.q: Sophie says the first day is "a little strange." She wants the new employee to feel…
options: calm — it is normal to feel this way
items.why: Inferência: ela normaliza o nervosismo do primeiro dia para deixar a pessoa tranquila.

items.q: Sophie says "we all make mistakes, and that is okay." This suggests she thinks…
options: it is fine to make mistakes while learning
the new employee must be perfect
items.why: Inferência: ela encoraja falar sem medo — errar faz parte de aprender.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Many people work at Czarnikow." People means…
items.why: People = pessoas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I work in a big ___ in London."
items.why: Office = escritório, o lugar onde você trabalha.

items.q: "We are a small team." Team means…
items.why: Team = time / equipe.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Czarnikow is a food ___."
items.why: Company = empresa.

items.q: "My job is to help you." Job means…
items.why: Job = emprego / função.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do primeiro dia de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Welcome aboard! We are happy you are here." Welcome aboard means…
items.why: Welcome aboard = bem-vindo(a) ao time.

items.q: "Take your time to settle in." To settle in means to…
options: get comfortable in a new place
items.why: Settle in = se adaptar, se acostumar com o lugar novo.

items.q: "If you need something, I can help out." To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, ajudar.

items.q: "Sophie will show you around the office." To show someone around means to…
options: take them to see the place
items.why: Show around = mostrar o lugar para alguém.

items.q: "Please fill in this form with your name." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (um formulário).
